headline: Congo bans exports of copper and cobalt concentrates
summary: A government order reviewed by Reuters blocks concentrate exports to force domestic processing, shaking global battery-metal supply chains.
script: The Democratic Republic of Congo has banned exports of copper and cobalt concentrate. The government order aims to force more domestic processing of the battery metals. The move is shaking global supply chains, with copper prices moving on the news.
imageAlt: An aerial view of a large open-pit copper and cobalt mine in DR Congo.
imageAltTwo: Heavy trucks haul ore on terraced levels of an open-pit mine.
